source.period_note: GA last 30 days in property timezone; GSC query/page table last 90 days in America/Los_Angeles. Exact GA date boundaries/timezone were not exposed in the action summary. Do not combine these periods.

gamma_canva.zero_basis: Returned affiliate page rows: home=6, offers hub=2, Pictory tool=1; sum=9 equals aggregate=9, only 3 rows below limit20. Gamma is absent. Historical traffic may include operational checks.

prioritization.method: Ordered evidence buckets, descending observed views/impressions within each bucket; no invented revenue score. Search candidates require page/query intent review before editing. Low ranking is not proven title failure.

affiliate_audit.pending_policy: 22 existing submitted/pending programs reviewed against fresh Gmail search; no new approval inferred; no duplicate applications or unsolicited repeated followups sent.

change_preflight.actual_problem: Highest-view known buyer comparison has 91 views/82 users and no recorded affiliate clicks in the baseline; its 760px minimum-width table is awkward on narrow screens and existing decision tool has no exposure/use/copy measurements. Prior Sep20/Sep24 improvements fall inside this window, so the baseline does not prove those fixes ineffective.
change_preflight.user_impact: Mobile readers must horizontally navigate a comparison table and scroll to existing decision assistance.
change_preflight.expected_effect: Hypothesis: easier comparison and navigation may increase qualified CTA use. Added observations will show whether users see/use the flow. No conversion or revenue uplift claimed.
change_preflight.existing_features: Reuse existing scenario selector/copyable brief, current 3 Gamma CTAs, existing pricing guide; no new buyer tool or page.
change_preflight.complexity: Small static HTML/CSS and bounded browser events; optional GA aggregate query.
change_preflight.cost: No new service, spend, secret or account. One additional report in existing analytics job.
change_preflight.maintenance_risk: Producer overwrite and duplicate events; full repeated build plus isolated clipboard/exposure tests protect behavior.
change_preflight.measurement: Record post-deploy full 7/30-day windows separately from baseline; same timezone/window for page views, affiliate clicks, exposure and usage. Exclude QA where identifiable; disclose residual contamination. Low counts are not statistical uplift proof.
